_note: Who each merchant says its members are. Authored 13/09/2026. The server reads this and nothing else when answering 'is this shopper a member' -- an agent sends an id, the merchant answers from here. There is deliberately no global roster: membership is a relationship with one merchant, so the same shopper is a Circle member at Voltway and a stranger at NorthGear.
_why_not_in_manifests: manifests.json says what a merchant publishes to every agent. A roster is per-shopper and is never published -- it is only ever consulted for an id the shopper's own agent supplied.
